plan.summary: This PR changes the text that `statusLabel` returns for a stack member that needs a rebase. The label changes from 'needs rebasing' to 'needs to move'. The check in `needsRebase` and the 'up to date' label stay the same.
plan.riskRationale: This is a one-line change to a display string. The condition is unchanged. Any code or test that compares the old string 'needs rebasing' would break, and the evidence does not show such code.
plan.storyArc: One string changes in `statusLabel`. The reviewer only needs to check the new wording and look for other users of the old text.

topics.title: Rename the rebase status label to 'needs to move'
topics.narrativeBrief: What text does `statusLabel` return now for a member that needs a rebase? Check that the condition is unchanged, and verify whether other code or tests depend on the old string 'needs rebasing'.
